The request snapshot card, reason, evidence and decision note are kept (real data, behavior preserved).

omittedDrawnElements.requestId: '#LR-2048' has no source (D6). The status notice shows the real short request id (first 8 hex characters of the request id) instead.
omittedDrawnElements.sla: 'Most reviews take 2-3 days' / 'Usually 2-3 days' have no source (D6): omitted. Intro copy states only that a Platform Admin reviews the request; the open timeline step says it is waiting for review.
omittedDrawnElements.stepper: 'Level you think fits' with -/+ and a single value 4.1: the stored request is a min/max range (D6). The form keeps Exact level / Range text fields with the same validation.
omittedDrawnElements.stickyBar: Sticky action bar not adopted (matches U17 league forms): the submit and cancel actions follow the content.

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Chromium 390 CSS px, deviceScaleFactor 1, light, en. The live region (clipped from a full-page capture at the element top) is compared with the same-size region of the scale-1 Pencil PNG, pinned perceptual threshold (35215 x 0.1^2). Regions: qWosG topbar (frame y 48-96, aligned on the back link top), qWosG card (frame y 164-234, aligned on the level card top), qWosG evidence (frame y 404-452, aligned on the disclosure trigger), OKYtp topbar, OKYtp approved (frame y 347-435) and OKYtp rejected (frame y 449-538) on a request under review, aligned on each card top. Structural probes (order, 48px back target, 17/700 title, gutters, 14px rhythm, radii, mark and glyph sizes, tone fills, no invented id/SLA, >=44px targets, no overflow) assert exactly and are independent of the budgets.

perScreenRationale.qWosG:topbar: Observed residual 0.0755 on the back-link-aligned 390x48 region; 0.095 leaves 0.0195 for cross-renderer variance. Intentional adaptation, not a layout defect: the frame centers the title between a 48px back target and a 72px empty action, production keeps the title next to the back target (shared with the league and community headers); the 48px target, 17/700 title and row alignment are exact structural probes.
perScreenRationale.qWosG:card: Observed residual 0.1276 on the level-card-aligned 390x70 region; 0.148 leaves 0.0204 for cross-renderer variance. Residual is the frame's sample figures ('3.82 · 76% reliable' with a -/+ stepper row) versus the real level and reliability copy and the real helper line (D6); card radius, hairline and gutters are exact structural probes.
perScreenRationale.qWosG:evidence: Observed residual 0.1240 on the disclosure-aligned 390x48 region; 0.144 leaves 0.02 for cross-renderer variance. Residual is the label wording ('Add optional evidence' versus '+ Add evidence (optional)') and the leading glyph placement; the 48px height, 14px radius and line border are exact structural probes.
perScreenRationale.OKYtp:topbar: Observed residual 0.0744 on the back-link-aligned 390x48 region; 0.094 leaves 0.0196 for cross-renderer variance. Same title-position adaptation as the request top bar.
perScreenRationale.OKYtp:approved: Observed residual 0.1005 on the 'If approved' card region of a request under review; 0.12 leaves 0.0195 for cross-renderer variance. Residual is card height (production copy wraps differently at the real font metrics) and glyph rasterization; the 20px hairline radius, 40px glyph and green-soft tone are exact structural probes.
perScreenRationale.OKYtp:rejected: Observed residual 0.0721 on the 'If rejected' card region; 0.092 leaves 0.0199 for cross-renderer variance. Same documented causes as the approved card; the 40px surface-2 glyph and 20px radius are exact structural probes.
